record.notes: Intends to take an active part in the international network. The BSI institute page describes AISI Deutschland as still being set up. BSI publishes a digest, 'Aktuelle KI-Sicherheitsthemen' (issues 08, 09 and 10/2026), as part of setting up the institute; the August issue names AISI Deutschland as recommending in-depth investigation of frontier models but not their broad deployment. The digests are BSI's, not counted as institute outputs. The government's answer of 19 October 2026 leaves the institute's further design, remit, organisational and legal form, staffing, technical equipment and budget under discussion. Parliamentary scrutiny runs through the responsible ministries. The federal government's AI taskforce report of 2 November 2026 calls the current stage an initiation phase and plans to expand the institute step by step into an independent national competence and evaluation institute (build-up phase II).

testing_capacity.notes: Focus statement, not counted as testing: in the first phase of operation 'liegt ein wichtiger Schwerpunkt in der Analyse und Bewertung führender KI-Modelle' (an important focus is the analysis and assessment of leading AI models). In a first phase the Federal Office for Information Security (BSI) and the Federal Network Agency form a virtual nucleus of the institute. BSI's institute page says 'Zurzeit befindet sich das Institut noch im Aufbau. Der Fokus liegt zunächst auf der Beratung von Verwaltung und Politik' (the institute is still being set up; the initial focus is advising government and policy-makers). The government's answer of 19 October 2026 says the institute initially pools existing BSI and BNetzA capabilities and uses and develops existing testing and evaluation methods. It says no separate posts are allocated for the first phase, and that technical equipment and further capacity remain under discussion. The UK-Germany joint statement of 30 June 2026 says both countries 'will share best practice on AI evaluation'. The federal government's AI taskforce report 'Deutschland als KI-Nation 2030' of 2 November 2026 sets a target for 2030 that the institute examine and assess at least 75 per cent of new frontier AI models for security-policy impact within four months.

model_access.notes: BSI states 'Das AISI Deutschland übernimmt ausdrücklich keine Regulierungs- oder Marktüberwachungsfunktion' (AISI Deutschland expressly takes on no regulatory or market-surveillance function). The government's written answer of 6 October 2026 to a parliamentary question says the institute has 'eine wichtige Rolle beim Zugang zu Frontier-KI-Modellen, der internationalen Vernetzung und bei der Bewertung von Sicherheitsrisiken und -anforderungen' (an important role in access to frontier AI models, international networking and assessing security risks and requirements). In the answer of 19 October 2026, the government reports discussions with leading developers and providers to secure access to the most capable models for the institute. It says no independent institute power to compel information or model access is envisaged; any necessary public-authority access rights follow the competent authorities' statutory powers, especially the AI Act.

staffing_model.notes: In the first phase BSI covers (cyber) security and BNetzA safety, and other security-sector bodies are to be closely involved; a second phase is to expand the institute's capacity. The government's answer of 19 October 2026 confirms that no separate posts are allocated for the first phase: the virtual BSI/BNetzA nucleus uses the two bodies' existing resources and expertise. This is not a staff count.

claims.text: Its founding ministries' launch statement makes analysing and evaluating leading AI models, above all their cybersecurity capabilities and risks, an important focus of its current first phase.
Its core tasks, as listed on the BSI's page for the institute, include international technology watch and situation analysis.
The federal government's AI taskforce report says it provides current situation pictures with early-warning indicators.
Its core tasks, as listed on the BSI's page for the institute, include strategic advice to the federal government on AI-related security and sovereignty questions.
Its founding ministries' announcement says it will work closely with comparable institutions in other states and with multilateral structures.
The federal government's announcement of its opening says it is to act as the central interface for analysing and countering the new security risks that rapid progress in AI brings.
The BSI's AI security bulletin says AISI Deutschland has again pointed out that the BSI strongly recommends using AI for vulnerability searches and software quality assurance.
The federal government says existing test and evaluation methods are used and further developed at AISI Deutschland.

The digital ministry's announcement of the institute's start says technical exchanges with international partner institutions, including in France, the UK and the EU AI Office, are already taking place.
The BSI's page on the institute lists among its core tasks analysing the security-relevant effects of AI on government, business and society.

excerpts.text: Hierfür werden bestehende Kapazitäten zur Risiko- und Fähigkeitsanalyse moderner KI-Modelle durch das AISI Deutschland zentral gebündelt und ausgebaut.
excerpts.gloss: To this end, existing capacities for risk and capability analysis of modern AI models are pooled centrally and expanded by AISI Deutschland.

excerpts.text: Rasante Fortschritte in der künstlichen Intelligenz bieten zahlreiche Chancen, bringen aber auch neue Sicherheitsrisiken mit sich: Das neu eröffnete KI-Sicherheitsinstitut AISI Deutschland soll künftig als zentrale Schnittstelle für die Analyse und Abwehr dieser Gefahren agieren.
excerpts.gloss: Rapid progress in artificial intelligence offers many opportunities but also brings new security risks: the newly opened AI security institute AISI Deutschland is in future to act as the central interface for analysing and countering these dangers.

excerpts.gloss: AISI Deutschland initially pools existing expertise and capacity, particularly of BSI and the Federal Network Agency, for the technical analysis and evaluation of advanced AI models and their risks. Existing testing and evaluation methods are used and developed for this purpose.

excerpts.text: Die Bundesregierung steht in engem Austausch mit den führenden KI-Entwicklern und Anbietern, um einen Zugang zu den leistungsfähigsten KI-Modellen für das AISI Deutschland sicherzustellen.
excerpts.gloss: The government is in close dialogue with leading AI developers and providers to secure access to the most capable AI models for AISI Deutschland.

excerpts.text: Das AISI Deutschland ist als Kompetenzzentrum und nicht als Regulierungsbehörde ausgestaltet.
excerpts.gloss: AISI Deutschland is a competence centre, not a regulator.

excerpts.text:
Eine eigenständige Befugnis des AISI Deutschland, gegen den Willen von Entwicklern, Anbietern oder Betreibern fortgeschrittener KI-
Modelle Informationen oder Modellzugang zu verlangen, ist daher nicht vorge-
sehen.
excerpts.gloss: An independent power for AISI Deutschland to require information or model access against the wishes of developers, providers or operators of advanced AI models is therefore not envisaged.

excerpts.text: Soweit für technische Evaluierungen hoheitliche Informations- oder Zugriffsrechte erforderlich sind, richten sich diese nach den jeweils einschlägigen gesetzlichen Befugnissen der zuständigen Behörden, insbesondere nach der europäischen KI-Verordnung (KI-VO).
excerpts.gloss: Where public-authority information or access rights are required for technical evaluations, these follow the relevant statutory powers of the competent authorities in each case, in particular the European AI Regulation (KI-VO).

excerpts.text: Das AISI Deutschland unterliegt dabei insbesondere der parlamentarischen Kontrolle über die für seinen Aufbau und seine Steuerung zuständigen Ressorts. Ein eigenständiger regelmäßiger Bericht des AISI Deutschland an den Deutschen Bundestag ist nicht vorgesehen.
excerpts.gloss: AISI Deutschland is subject in particular to parliamentary scrutiny through the ministries responsible for its establishment and direction. No separate regular report by AISI Deutschland to the Bundestag is envisaged.

excerpts.text: Der weitere organisatorische, personelle und finanzielle Auf- und Ausbau des AISI Deutschland erfolgt schrittweise, ein konkreter Zeitpunkt für dessen Abschluss ist daher bislang nicht festgelegt.
excerpts.gloss: The further organisational, staffing and financial development and expansion of AISI Deutschland proceeds step by step; no specific date for its completion has therefore yet been set.
